control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: lock out tag out failure on P-8304

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-8304 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically selecting, fit-testing and maintaining respirators. P-8304 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 10 January 2014 an incident occurred on P-8304 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
